source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At fixed revision0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, test_init_withRecentUpdate assigns NotificationUpdater.onUpdate=sinon.spy(resolve), primes the cache with _fetch and then resets/asserts updateSpy instead. updateSpy is a different spy from the callback currently registered. The zero-call assertion alone cannot detect an extra invocation of that registered callback during init. Proposed focused correction: observe the registered spy and distinguish its priming call from calls during init. Keep the separate structured initResult and scheduleSpy assertions; this is a specific callback-oracle gap, not a claim the entire test has no value. Exact source and full assigned discussion inspected; no isolated-task or runtime failure reproduced.
title: Check the registered callback in the cached notification-init test
